title: decomp.yaml
description: A matching-decompilation project's settings, shared by the tools that work on it: the decomp_settings format (https://github.com/ethteck/decomp_settings), as its official reader 0.0.10 declares it.

discord.description: An invite link to the project's Discord server.

platform.description: The platform the project's game or program runs on.

build_system.description: The build system the project uses.

versions.description: Every version of the target the project decompiles, such as each region or revision.

tools.description: Settings for each tool, keyed by the tool's name. Each tool defines its own block.

name.description: A short identifier for the version, easy to type.

sha1.description: The SHA-1 of the target binary, so tools can check they work on the right one.

target.description: The original binary the project matches, often called the baserom.

build_dir.description: The directory the build writes its artifacts to.

map.description: The map file the build writes.

compiled_target.description: The binary the project's build produces.

elf.description: The intermediate ELF the build produces, if any.

expected_dir.description: The directory of expected build output to compare against, often a copy of the build directory.

nonmatchings.description: The directory of functions or files that do not match the target yet.

compressed_target.description: The original binary before decompression, if the target is compressed.

compressed_compiled_target.description: The compressed binary the build produces, if any.

paths.description: The files and directories tools need for this version, relative to the decomp.yaml's directory.
